products.name: Decktopus
products.note: AI presentation maker; automated design; content generation; data exposure

profile_text.body:
Decktopus is an AI-powered presentation maker that describes itself as able to generate a complete, ready-to-present deck from a single topic description, covering structure, content, and design without requiring the user to build an outline or start from a blank slide. The product can also accept an uploaded file and redesign every slide's look, colors, layout, and typography while preserving the original content. Additional features include custom slide templates that the AI populates for each new use, brand extraction via a website URL, integration with ChatGPT as a tagged app, and Zapier connectivity for triggering automated presentation generation from CRM updates or form submissions. Presentations can be shared by link or exported as PDF, PPT, or PNG.

On data handling, the company states that data is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256, hosted on AWS infrastructure, and that customer data is not used for AI training. SOC 2 Type II compliance is described as currently in progress. The platform does not offer a free plan but provides free credits at signup sufficient to create a three-slide presentation. The held facts note a product flag for data exposure alongside the core AI presentation and automated design capabilities, which is consistent with the site's disclosure that the compliance certification is still ongoing.
